dialogue_texts: But look at this amulet she dropped... the spiritual signature on it doesn't match hers at all.
It's a sealing charm used to invert the glohm.
It seems the 'Sweeper' is acting under someone else's strict orders. Or perhaps, a curse.
How perceptive for a pair of intruders.
But spatial distortion is merely the threshold of this bewildered parallel.
There you are. You're the one pulling the strings, aren't you?
Step aside, or I'll purify you right here.
Purify me? Architectural boundaries and parallel flows obey my command tonight, Your Honor.
Let us see if your amulets can find their target when 'forward' no longer exists!
